author: N. R. Madison
title: Champaign and Urbana announce Halloween trick-or-treat hours for October 31
text:
Champaign | wikipedia.org
Champaign | wikipedia.org
Halloween trick-or-treating in the City of Champaign, City of Urbana, and Champaign County will take place from 6:00 pm to 8:00 pm on Friday, October 31, 2025. This schedule follows the guidelines approved by the Champaign County Board, which have been historically agreed upon by both cities.
According to these guidelines, Halloween trick-or-treating is always held on October 31. If the date falls on a weekday, as it does this year, hours are set from 6:00 pm to 8:00 pm. When October 31 lands on a weekend, trick-or-treating hours shift to an earlier slot from 5:00 pm to 7:00 pm.
The rules aim to provide consistency for families and residents across the county regarding Halloween activities.
